question: pH
answer: The pH of a 50 % concentration of A30 in (52.6% dioxane/ water was calculated to be 8.13 at 24 C according to the extrapolation procedures by Dr. P. D. Schickedantz, Lorillard Research Center Accession Number 1662, Reference OR 83- 81.

question: ORAL
answer: Reference OR 100- 32 . 5g A30 soluble in .5 mL corn oil at room temperature.

question: ACUTE CARDIOVASCULAR
answer: (See SOP for Determination of Solubility of Materials for Acute Cardiovascular and Respiratory Effects Study in Beagle Dogs) Reference OR 100- 32 .2 mg A30 soluble in .5 mL 10 % propylene glycol solution at 38 C. Add A30 to warm (38 C) propylene glycol; add warm water to make 10 % propylene glycol solution.
